item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] TPA to replace 54-year-old air traffic control tower with FAA-approved funding
item.description: Tampa International Airport is set to build a new $155 million air traffic control tower to replace its aging facility, including $18 million in modern technology from the Federal Aviation Administration.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Spoto High student arrested for making bomb threat against school: HCSO
item.description: A Spoto High student was arrested Thursday after deputies said he called the school and made a bomb threat.
